invitations.description: Invite people to join your chapter. They get a link to sign up with their details filled in.

form.title: Invite someone to join
form.description: They receive a link to sign up with these details filled in.
form.demIdOptional: Optional. They can add or correct it when signing up.

created.title: Invitation ready
created.simulated: Prototype: no email is sent. Share the link yourself.
created.preApproved: You can approve accounts, so their account opens as soon as they sign up.
created.needsVerification: After they sign up, an administrator verifies the account.

invitations.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the link and copy it.
invitations.emptyDescription: Invitations you send appear here until they are accepted.

revoke.title: Revoke the invitation for {{name}}?
revoke.description: The link stops working. You can invite them again later.

accept.title: Accept your invitation
accept.emailFixed: The address the invitation was sent to. It becomes your username.
accept.smsOnly: The invitation link confirmed your email. In production the code would arrive by SMS; this prototype shows it here.
accept.readyBody: You were invited by someone who can approve accounts, so you can sign in now.
accept.invalidBody: It may have been used already, withdrawn, or expired after 14 days. Ask the person who invited you for a new one, or sign up yourself.

errors.invalidLink: This invitation link no longer works.
errors.emailMismatch: Use the email address the invitation was sent to.
errors.fixed: This is set by the invitation.
errors.alreadyMember: This email address already belongs to an account.
errors.alreadyInvited: This email address already has an open invitation.
errors.notPending: Only open invitations can be revoked.
